name: thrivecart
description: ThriveCart MCP server and CLI for Claude Code and AI agents. 24 tools for products, offers, transactions, revenue, customers, subscriptions and affiliates, across several carts at once.
long_description:
Connects Claude to ThriveCart.

There is no OAuth app to register. An API token from Settings, then API & webhooks, then API tokens is the whole setup.

One token reaches exactly one cart, so several carts means several tokens. Configure them as a JSON array and every tool takes an account argument, so figures from one cart are never silently added to another.

This touches money and customer records. refund_transaction moves real funds and cancel_subscription ends a customer's access; both refuse to run without an explicit confirmation, and neither can be undone from here. Turn Read only on to remove every write from the tool list.

api_key.title: ThriveCart API token
api_key.description: From your ThriveCart dashboard: Settings, then API & webhooks, then API tokens. Not your account password. One token reaches one cart.

account_name.title: Name for this cart
account_name.description: What to call this cart when a tool reports on it, for example navid-media. Defaults to "default".

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can refund, cancel, pause, resume or create. Leaves the 19 reading tools.

allow_destructive.title: Allow refunds and cancellations
allow_destructive.description: Turn this off to keep pause, resume and create affiliate while blocking refund_transaction and cancel_subscription, the two that cannot be undone.
